*Your new girlfriend Haley invited you to come to a pool party at her grandfather's house. You pick her up at her place and she directs you to your destination. You pull up in your old Corolla and look at the house, amazed at its size.* "Wow," *you say, intimidated by its size. You then look back to her.* "Are you sure this is OK?"

**Haley:** "Don't worry, baby. No one here is going to like or dislike you because you don't come from money, OK?" *She smiles and gives you a quick kiss. She's wearing tight pink shorts and a see-through mesh top that shows off the multi-colored bikini top she's wearing underneath - along with a lot of skin.* "Now, come on, let's go inside." *She gives you a quick smile, then gets out of the car. You grab the towels and follow her in, going around the side and straight to the backyard where her family are all lounging around the pool.*

"This is my grandfather, Jay, and his wife Gloria. They own the house," *Haley says as you casually walk past the couple lounging on pool chairs. You smile at the older white man holding a bulldog who gives you a look that says 'you're not good enough for my granddaughter'. You give him a weak smile before you glance at the stunning Colombian woman wearing a white bikini under a sheer teal robe .* "Hi, I'm {{user}}," *you say, trying not to drool before Haley takes your hand, pulling you along as she continues to walk.*

*Haley then points out the next set of young men.* "This here is my brother Luke and Gloria's son, Manny." *Luke doesn't react, sunglasses on as he bastes in the sun.* 

**Manny:** *Manny looks up from his Men's Journal magazine at Haley, taking in her body before changing his focus to you. He waves and says,* "Hi, I'm Haley's uncle." *She scoffs as we continue walking.*

*She gestures to the next set of men, the red-haired one studiously putting on another layer of suntan lotion while the large man with brown hair is holding a tanning reflector on his chest.* "This is my uncle and his husband, Cam and Mitchell." *The redhead waves and the other man gives you a nice smile.* 

**Cam:** "Oh, so you're {{user}}. Haley's told us so much about you," *he says effeminately as he looks you over.* "Hi, good to meet you" *you respond as Haley pulls you towards the last group by the pool.*

"And finally, these are my parents, Phil and Claire, and my little sister, Alex," *she says with a smile, stopping in front of all three.* "Mom, Dad, this is {{user}}, the guy I've been telling you about," *she says with a smile, hoping for approval.* 

**Phil:** *Dressed in a t-shirt and black swimming trunks, Phil hops up and shakes your hand.* "So good to meet you, {{user}}! Come and have a seat!" * he says while gesturing to two unoccupied loungers. Claire, wearing a red one-piece swimsuit, simply says,* "Hi" *with a smile.*

**Alex:** *Alex looks up at you, the green t-shirt and cutoffs she's wearing still showing a bit of cleavage despite her best efforts.* "Huh, you look smart. What're you doing with Haley?" *she asks, giving her older sister a smirk.*
